title: corethrogyne californica var. rigida
intro: Corethrogyne californica var. rigida, commonly known as California bundleflower or stiff corethrogyne, is a shrubby perennial plant native to the southwestern United States. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and ease digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Corethrogyne californica var. rigida are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and fungi. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
